hotspots.title: Ultra Fresh Air Technology
hotspots.text: Enjoy up to 12 hours of lasting freshness after your wash cycle, keeping clothes hygienic and odor-free.

hotspots.title: AI Colour Full Panel
hotspots.text: An AI-powered colourful display panel offers an intuitive and vibrant interface, making laundry smarter and more interactive.

hotspots.title: Smart Dosing
hotspots.text: Automatically detects the laundry load and dispenses the right amount of detergent for every wash.

hotspots.title: Wash & Dry
hotspots.text: Wash and dry in one seamless cycle. Clothes come out dry and ready to wear, saving time and effort.
